# Dodora — account brief

## Who

Dodora is a GitHub organization with 2 public repos and 11 followers ([source](https://github.com/DodoraApp)). The evidence does not describe what the company does beyond its GitHub org profile ([source](https://github.com/DodoraApp)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in DodoraApp/DodoStream ([source](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream/blob/main/eas.json))
- CI workflows are configured in DodoraApp/DodoStream ([source](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream/tree/main/.github/workflows))
- DodoraApp/DodoStream last pushed 2026-08-04 ([source](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream))

## Who to talk to

- Fabian (@Kombustor), top contributor to DodoraApp/DodoStream with 163 commits ([source](https://github.com/Kombustor))
- Shivam Vijaywargi (@shivamvijaywargi), 2 commits to DodoraApp/DodoStream ([source](https://github.com/shivamvijaywargi)). Profile lists location "Hyderabad, India", website https://shivamvijaywargi.dev/ and bio "🌟 Exploring the Boundless Possibilities of Development 💻🚀" ([source](https://github.com/shivamvijaywargi))
- @skearney414, 2 commits to DodoraApp/DodoStream ([source](https://github.com/skearney414))

## Why now

DodoraApp/DodoStream last pushed 2026-08-04 ([source](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream)). The evidence contains no React Native version and no app store release data, so update cadence cannot be assessed.

## Suggested opener

Fabian, you have 163 commits to DodoraApp/DodoStream, the most of any contributor ([source](https://github.com/Kombustor)). The repo has an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream/blob/main/eas.json)) alongside GitHub Actions workflows ([source](https://github.com/DodoraApp/DodoStream/tree/main/.github/workflows)). How do those workflows hand off to EAS today, and what part of that build pipeline takes the most of your time?
